props.text: View quality check status and details for all jobs across all machines and lines.

onChange.script:
# line changed -> refresh machine options for that line, clear stale machine
	lineId = currentValue.value if currentValue.value is not None else -1
	mds = system.db.runNamedQuery(system.util.getProjectName(), "qc/GetMachineOptions", {"lineId": lineId})
	opts = [{"value": mds.getValueAt(i, "MachineID"), "label": mds.getValueAt(i, "MachineCode")}
	        for i in range(mds.getRowCount())]
	self.view.custom.machineOptions = opts
	if not quality_report.machineValidForLine(self.view.custom.filters.machineId, opts):
		self.view.custom.filters.machineId = None

messageHandlers.script:
data = quality_report.loadReport(dict(self.view.custom.filters))
	self.view.custom.reportRows     = data['rows']
	self.view.custom.counts         = data['counts']
	self.view.custom.lineOptions    = data['lineOptions']
	self.view.custom.machineOptions = data['machineOptions']
